fact: CRAN announced on 16 April 2026 awards of N$32.3m to MTC and N$9.8m to Telecom Namibia for Universal Service Fund phase 2, with N$107.1m allocated to phases 2 and 3 and a further N$78m for 2026/27; the article does not tie the fund explicitly to the broadband policy.
title: Namibia Pours $6.5 Million into Universal Access Fund Expansion
